dict.string: Folio transcribes your meeting's audio on this Mac. The recording never leaves the device.
Folio captures the audio from your meeting apps on this Mac so it can be transcribed locally. The recording never leaves the device.
Folio captures the audio from your meeting's video conferencing app on this Mac. Only audio is read; the screen contents are not stored.
Folio reads your calendar to suggest the people you meet with and to detect when meetings start. Calendar data stays on your Mac.
Folio reads your calendar to suggest the people you meet with and to detect when meetings start. Calendar data stays on your Mac.
Folio reads your contacts so it can suggest who to invite to your workspace. Contacts stay on your Mac.
Folio writes meeting action items to a Reminders list you choose. Reminders stay in your iCloud account, not on Folio's servers.

Folio coordinates with system events to detect when your video-conferencing app starts a call and offer to capture it.
Folio does not use your location.
